title: Calculation of the ProBuild Rewards Discount on Ridgeline Tool Rental Time
content:
**Discount base.** The ProBuild rental discount on a Ridgeline Tool Rental agreement is worked out on the rental time billed on the agreement, leaving out any rental time billed at the weekend special.

**Discount.** A renter whose ProBuild membership was active on the checkout date, on an equipment class that earns the ProBuild discount, receives the ProBuild discount rate of the agreement applied once to that rental time as a flat percentage, and the discount is rounded to the nearest cent only at the end. A renter without a ProBuild membership active on the checkout date, or renting a class that does not earn the ProBuild discount, receives no discount. Whether a class earns the ProBuild discount is shown on the rate card.

**Active on the checkout date.** A membership counts as active on the checkout date when it was enrolled on or before the checkout date and its record shows it active, or shows it suspended or closed with the suspension or closing dated after the checkout date; a membership whose record shows it pending verification, or suspended or closed on or before the checkout date, does not count.

**Rate.** The ProBuild discount rate of the agreement is the rental discount percentage of the ProBuild tier the membership's record shows on the day the discount is posted, a percentage of zero included.

## Rental discount percentages of the Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards tiers

| ProBuild tier on the membership record | Rental discount percentage |
|---|---|
| ProBuild Member | 0 |
| ProBuild Bronze | 0 |
| ProBuild Silver | 5 |
| ProBuild Gold | 10 |
| ProBuild Platinum | 15 |
| ProBuild Platinum Elite | 20 |

## Membership on the checkout date

| Membership record (enrolled on or before the checkout date) | Counts as active on the checkout date |
|---|---|
| active | yes |
| suspended, suspension dated after the checkout date | yes |
| closed, closing dated after the checkout date | yes |
| suspended or closed on or before the checkout date | no |
| pending verification | no |

A membership enrolled after the checkout date does not count, whatever its record shows.

## Worked examples (hypothetical agreements)

| Rental time billed | Of which at the weekend special | Tier on the posting day | Discount |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 week at 350.00 and 2 days at 50.00 each, 450.00 | none | ProBuild Gold | 10 percent of 450.00, 45.00 |
| 333.33 | none | ProBuild Silver | 5 percent of 333.33 is 16.6665, rounded at the end to 16.67 |
| 60.00 | 60.00 | ProBuild Platinum | the base is 0.00, so 0.00 |
| 450.00 | none | membership enrolled the day after checkout | none |
